evidence: So the position is: the legacy platform is switched off when the last site goes live, the closed history is extracted first into an open self-describing archive, and the retention period comes from legal in writing before we sign anything with the vendor about decommissioning.
I want legal to give us one in writing.
Xavier, can you scope the extraction enough that I can put a number in front of the vendor?
Give me until the end of next week.

output.ask: I can see the shift — closed legacy history now gets pulled into a flat, self-describing archive rather than keeping the old vendor platform alive, and legal's retention mandate has to be in writing before any decommissioning terms get signed — but this run surfaced none of your existing documents to read that against, so point me at the cutover plan or the vendor-exit paperwork and I'll show you what changes there.
